cards.title: The Protégé Problem
cards.instruction: Treat another player as someone you trained. Offer corrections, backhanded praise, and reminders of your influence.

cards.title: There Is a Process
cards.instruction: Treat every favor, feeling, and urgent need as a request requiring terms, documentation, review, and approval.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll lend you my umbrella once we approve the loan. I taught you to say when something comes back; what's the proposed return date?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Good, you remembered a condition this time. It's open-ended, though. Name a guarantor who'll return it if you're delayed.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Write 'urgent' at the top, then sign. Under the umbrella if you must; you used to blur the terms before I'd finished checking them.

reason: Use the actual distinctive Drive with a particular former-pupil habit. Keep vocabulary corrections informative, restrictions warmly delivered, and B practical concerns responsible for A next choice.
